label: Italian-language AI
text: glm-ocr-ita (GLM-OCR fine-tuned for Italian documents, 8-bit MLX, on Hugging Face), a small Italian LM trained on MLX, Italian translation of oMLX upstream, ai-security (Italian guide). Priorities for OCR: quality, then speed, then size.
